entries.title: Batched pull requests wait until your project is set up for them
entries.body: When you choose batched pull requests for a project that has no workflow for its batch check yet, the project keeps sending changes as pull requests. A card says the project is not set up yet and offers to have the first mate plan the workflow. Once a workflow that mentions the batch check merges, the project switches to batched pull requests by itself. Not now keeps where its changes go.
